title: Why You Hear a Different Word Based on Mouth Shape
hook: Your brain can make you hear a different word entirely.

narration.text: Your brain can make you hear a different word entirely.
This happens when the sound you hear clashes with the mouth shape you see.
Your brain tries to combine both pieces of information.
It creates a third, entirely new sound as a compromise.
You can test this right now with a video of someone saying 'ba' but with 'ga' audio.
You will likely hear the sound 'da' instead.
Try it and tell me if it worked on you in the comments, like this if it surprised you, and subscribe for more mind-bending facts.

description: Have you ever heard something different from what was actually said? This video explains why your brain sometimes creates a new sound when visual and auditory information conflict. It's a fascinating insight into how our senses interact.
topic: Why your brain can make you hear a different word based on the mouth shape you see. You can test this right now with a video.
